expectations.text: Output contains exactly one record_type: page_map and evidence_class: page-evidence.
expectations.evidence: The frontmatter begins with record_type: page_map and its evidence item is page-evidence.

expectations.text: Does not claim a visible response for a control that was not operated; visible controls are listed as interaction candidates.
expectations.evidence: No control was operated; listed interactions are phrased as questions and the Notes state that no control was tested.

expectations.text: Records the requested public URL and states that no interaction was tested in limits.
expectations.evidence: The evidence URL matches the prompt; limits state that only the initial accessibility snapshot was used.

expectations.text: No formal corpus or pattern files are changed.
expectations.evidence: The run report says no corpus files were edited; this artifact is saved only in the evaluation workspace.

expectations.text: The page-map site string exactly matches the canonical corpus site IKEA; locale remains in page/context.
expectations.evidence: The output uses `site: IKEA US`, while `corpus/ikea/site.md` uses `site: IKEA`.

expectations.text: When browser capture succeeds, visible_structure and interaction_candidates contain concrete snapshot-based content rather than empty placeholders.
expectations.evidence: The output lists nine observed page regions and eight untested interaction candidates.

expectations.text: When the preferred browser surface fails and another supported surface is available, the run tries the fallback and records the actual tool and any isolation limitation.
expectations.evidence: The executor reports Chrome DevTools MCP was unavailable and then captured the page with an isolated Playwright CLI session; the evidence names that tool.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions are evidence-based; page-map and candidate tasks differentiate evidence constraints, while the interaction baseline remains blocked by browser setup.
